levels.surface: أبو علي أحمد بن محمد الصولي
أمير المؤمنين علي بن أبي طالب

notes: The unnamed «شيخ من أهل حضرموت» is a gap (rule 8), kept in place.

Ali speaks inside Ibn Hanafiyya's account (فقال له أمير المؤمنين: هذا دعاؤك؟), so he is the last link (owner ruling 5). Khidr is named in the text as the man and speaks at the end (فقال له الرجل وهو الخضر); the reading keeps Ali as the last link, and Khidr is a scene speaker, not a route.
The reading is close, but a second reading (Ibn Hanafiyya as last link) exists; no ruling is needed under rule 11.
